description: AT-26 Xavante FAB 4587 donated by the FAB and displayed in the central square honouring aviator Euclides Pinto Martins. In June 2023 the municipality announced the jet would be moved to the Pinto Martins regional airport and replaced by a replica of the 'Sampaio Correia II' seaplane; a Feb 2026 compilation still lists it at the praça. Current position (praça or airport) needs checking.
